svg.title: The route: eight stops from your Odoo version to Odoo 20.0
svg.desc: The route: stop 01 doctor: Checks Odoo 20, Python 3.12+, PostgreSQL 16+ and Chrome (doctor.sh, gate ready); stop 02 prepare: Copies the module, detects its version, commits a baseline (prepare.sh, gate baseline); stop 03 upgrade_code: Runs Odoo's own rewrite scripts one by one, core untouched (run_upgrade_code.sh, gate core untouched); stop 04 scan: 100+ known breaks: silent ones, signatures, xmlids, secrets (scan.py, gate 0 blocker / 0 silent); stop 05 rewrite: Python, views, security, Owl 3, Interactions, per area (references/, gate commit per area); stop 06 install loop: Throwaway database, repeated until the install is clean (install_test.sh, gate result: clean); stop 07 smoke test: Odoo clickbot and website pages in headless Chrome (smoke_test.py, gate no console errors); stop 08 review + report: Code review, then MIGRATION_20.md with every decision (odoo-review, gate report)
